book.name: 1 Kolin
book.title: Mo꞉fo꞉s Agel We Fo꞉l Eyo꞉ Kolin Kaluka꞉isalemo꞉ Sa꞉sa꞉liga꞉fo꞉

content: Keliso kaluka꞉isale gegelebo꞉ mo꞉walila꞉so꞉bo

Keliso kaluka꞉isale gio꞉ gegelebo꞉ kegaki aloba꞉ma꞉no꞉wo꞉ dowalikiyo꞉, ha꞉la꞉ kalulo꞉ amilo꞉ mo꞉walilima꞉no꞉ tililia꞉ ha꞉nab a꞉no꞉ mo꞉ililo꞉. A꞉la꞉bo꞉ mo꞉dimidaki, giliyo꞉ sa꞉s usa digalalega a꞉no꞉ o꞉li.

Tif amio꞉ Gode amilo꞉ tilidabu niliyo꞉ henfelo꞉ kaluka꞉isaleya꞉lo꞉ dimidan a꞉no꞉ o꞉lika aloba꞉ma꞉ib a꞉la꞉bo꞉ gio꞉ mo꞉asulaya? A꞉la꞉bo꞉ giliyo꞉ hendele dimidama꞉ib ko꞉lo꞉, to ha꞉lu ko꞉lo꞉ gi usamilo꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowab we, giliyo꞉ mo꞉aloba꞉dab a꞉no꞉, asulo꞉wo꞉ babale dowabiki gaya?

A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ tif amio꞉ ma꞉mula꞉ kalu i a꞉no꞉ giliyo꞉ o꞉lika aloba꞉ma꞉ib a꞉labo꞉ mo꞉asulaya? Niliyo꞉ a꞉la꞉bo꞉ o꞉li dimidama꞉no꞉ da꞉lab ko꞉lo꞉, henfelo꞉ amilo꞉ ha꞉lu kelego꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowab a꞉no꞉ niliyo꞉ tambowo꞉ o꞉lika alobana sa꞉ma꞉no꞉.
A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ tilidabu kaluka꞉isale gi usamio꞉ to kegaki, digalema꞉no꞉wo꞉ dowab amio꞉, giliyo꞉ to a꞉no꞉ digalema꞉kiyo꞉, ha꞉la꞉ kalu, sa꞉s us amilo꞉ wilo꞉ mo꞉da꞉lab o꞉mo꞉lo꞉ dimiab ko mo꞉wo꞉ ha꞉?
Niyo꞉ to we gio꞉ sendelo alitaki so꞉lo꞉l. Tilidabu kaluka꞉isale gi us a꞉namio꞉ to kegaki aloba꞉ma꞉no꞉ dowalikilo꞉ asulo꞉lo꞉ di kalu digalema꞉no꞉ nowo꞉ gi us amio꞉ aundo꞉ma ko꞉lo꞉laba?
Ko꞉sega gio꞉ gegelebo꞉ mo꞉digalaki, ao noma꞉yo꞉ ao nowo꞉ ha꞉la꞉ kalumo꞉ alobanama꞉kiyo꞉, gamaniya꞉lo꞉ mo꞉walila꞉sen a꞉na tililia꞉gane. A꞉la꞉do꞉ gab a꞉no꞉ mo꞉ililo꞉.

Sa꞉s gi us amio꞉ ao a꞉la꞉ nowo꞉ ha꞉la꞉ya꞉ siwa꞉la mo꞉walilima꞉no꞉ kagayab a꞉ma꞉yo꞉, gio꞉ Godeya꞉lo꞉ asulab aumbo꞉ mo꞉kudu ho꞉no꞉l a꞉la꞉widakigab. Gao noma꞉yo꞉ gi asulo꞉lo꞉ mogagab a꞉no꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉bo꞉ sa꞉la꞉so꞉bo. Gi kelego꞉ gao noma꞉lo꞉ afaledo꞉ diab a꞉no꞉ gio꞉ kata꞉ta꞉bi.

Ko꞉sega giliyo꞉ man nafa dimidama꞉no꞉ da꞉lab a꞉no꞉ mo꞉kudu ha꞉naki, gegelebo꞉ kelego꞉ noma꞉lo꞉ da꞉lab a꞉no꞉ gi susulu sa꞉la꞉la꞉lab a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉, giliyo꞉ man mogago꞉wo꞉ dimida꞉lab. Man gililo꞉ dimidab a꞉no꞉ gaomo꞉ dimida꞉laka꞉.

Kaluka꞉isale mogago꞉lo꞉ dimida꞉lab a꞉no꞉ Godeya꞉lo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉mela꞉no꞉ hen a꞉namio꞉ mo꞉tina꞉ib a꞉la꞉bo꞉ gio꞉ mo꞉asulo꞉wo꞉? Man a꞉no꞉ we, uwo꞉lo꞉ dimida꞉labo꞉, madali godelo꞉ wabuda꞉labo꞉, ga nowo꞉ afa dia꞉labo꞉, da꞉lo꞉ dimia꞉labo꞉, kelego꞉ noma꞉no꞉lo꞉ afalo꞉ dia꞉labo꞉, mesela꞉labo꞉, aluna꞉ ho꞉n na꞉likilo꞉ no꞉nola꞉labo꞉, sada꞉da꞉labo꞉, noma꞉ kelego꞉wo꞉ dikidakilo꞉ susulu dia꞉labo꞉, kaluka꞉isale i a꞉no꞉ tambo Godeya꞉lo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉mela꞉no꞉ hen a꞉namio꞉ mada mo꞉tina꞉ib.

Tamin amio꞉ kaluka꞉isale gi nolo꞉ man a꞉no꞉ dimida꞉i ya꞉len. Ko꞉sega Alan Ya꞉su Kelisowa꞉ wiya, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Mama Malilo꞉ halaido꞉ a꞉na ilikiyo꞉, Gode eyo꞉ mogago꞉ a꞉no꞉ hala꞉sa꞉ga꞉, kaluka꞉isale eno꞉le ta꞉takiyo꞉, i a꞉no꞉ ene siwa꞉l amio꞉ digalo꞉ kaluka꞉isale a꞉la꞉bo꞉ a꞉na sio꞉.
Gili do꞉mo꞉wo꞉ Mama Malilo꞉wa꞉ a

Kalu nolba꞉ sa꞉lakiyo꞉, “Niyo꞉ kelego꞉ tambowo꞉ o꞉lika dimidama꞉no꞉” a꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉sen. A꞉, a꞉no꞉ hendele sa꞉lab ko꞉sega, kelego꞉ nol gilo꞉ dimidab a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ ge mo꞉asuwa꞉fa꞉ib. “Kelego꞉ tambowo꞉ niyo꞉ o꞉lika dimidama꞉no꞉,” ko꞉sega kelego꞉ imilig noma꞉yo꞉ ne tili dofo꞉ melea꞉kiyo꞉ mo꞉ta꞉fa꞉no꞉.

A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ kalu nolba꞉ bale sa꞉lakiyo꞉, “Ma꞉no꞉ a꞉no꞉ kufa꞉no꞉, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ kuf a꞉no꞉ ma꞉no꞉wa꞉no꞉ka꞉” a꞉la꞉sa꞉ma꞉ib. Ko꞉sega Gode eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉ a꞉no꞉ dila꞉ma꞉ib. Nili do꞉mo꞉ we uwo꞉ dia꞉melea꞉ki ta꞉foma. O꞉ngo꞉ma. Do꞉mo꞉ nilo꞉ we Kalu Alana꞉ eno꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, ene tili dofo꞉lab.
Godeya꞉ ene halaido꞉ a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ Alan sowo꞉ a꞉no꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉ a꞉dasi alifa꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, nio꞉lo꞉ eyo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉ a꞉dasi alifa꞉ib.

Gio꞉ to we asuluma. Gili do꞉mo꞉ ko Ya꞉suwa꞉ ene do꞉mo꞉ heb ko꞉lo꞉ a꞉lab. A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ niyo꞉ Kelisowa꞉ ene do꞉mo꞉ heb we dia꞉sa꞉ga꞉, uwo꞉ diakilo꞉ molelo꞉ dia꞉sen ga o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ gasa doma꞉no꞉wo꞉ o꞉liya꞉le? A꞉la꞉bo꞉ mada dimida꞉so꞉boka꞉!

Kalu abeyo꞉ e uwo꞉ diakilo꞉ molelo꞉ dia꞉sen ga o꞉lia꞉ ege dowalega, e ga a꞉no꞉lia꞉yo꞉ do꞉mo꞉ imilise dowab a꞉la꞉bo꞉ gio꞉ mo꞉asulaya? Godeya꞉ bugo꞉ amio꞉ towo꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉sa꞉lo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ da꞉lab, “A꞉la꞉yo꞉ do꞉mo꞉ imilise doma꞉ib.”
Ko꞉sega kalu abeyo꞉ e Alan amilo꞉ kudab a꞉no꞉, Alana꞉ mama amio꞉ imilise dowab.

Kaluka꞉isalelo꞉ man mogago꞉ nol dimidab a꞉no꞉ do꞉mo꞉ ha꞉la꞉ya dowab. Ko꞉sega kaluka꞉isale abeyo꞉ e uwo꞉wo꞉ dialega, ene do꞉mo꞉ a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ mogagilab. A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ gio꞉ ho꞉leno꞉ tambowo꞉ uwo꞉ dian man a꞉no꞉ gola ba꞉da꞉ga꞉, fa꞉s dimita꞉ga꞉ ha꞉na꞉bi.

Giliyo꞉ to we asuluma. Do꞉mo꞉ gililo꞉wo꞉ Mama Malilo꞉wa꞉ ayo꞉ o꞉m. Gode eyo꞉ Mama Malilo꞉wo꞉ gimo꞉ dimi ko꞉lo꞉, e gi usa a꞉lab. Gode eyo꞉ su alan sila꞉sa꞉ga꞉, gio꞉ a꞉na kilili ko꞉lo꞉, gili do꞉mo꞉ ko gilino꞉ma. A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ gili do꞉mo꞉wa꞉lo꞉ man dimidab a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ Godeyo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ wabuda꞉lubi.
